issues.detail: The Greek 'εuchēn echontes' (having a prayer) in this context refers to 'those who are praying' or 'the praying ones' (a state of being/action), whereas the Vietnamese 'đang giữ lời cầu nguyện' implies 'keeping/holding a prayer' (possessing a specific prayer), which changes the nuance of the action.
The Greek 'εφ εαυτων' (for themselves) is omitted in the Vietnamese translation.
